note: Eleven printables. All adult-facing text sits outside the cards. CUT ONCE: cards butt against each other with no gutters, and every cut line runs the full width or the full height of the page, edge to edge, so one straight stroke of the blade separates the cards on both sides of it. The lines are light-grey 0.25 mm hairlines — they are cut away, so a line IS the card edge — and a small black triangle at the 5.5 mm printer-safe margin marks each line where it meets the paper edge, because a hairline dies in the last few millimetres of any printer. Card content stops 4 mm inside every card edge, so a wandering blade never touches a photograph or a word. Footer on every sheet: “Cut along every grey line · N cards”. Sheets 02, 03 and 06 are MOUNTED on coloured backing card with a 1 cm border, so their printed size is 20 mm smaller than the finished card; 04, 05, 09 and 11 are not mounted and print at finished size.

items.title: Sound-frame mat — 3-frame 70 mm / 4-frame 66 mm
items.cut: Cut along every grey line: four lines, two down the sheet and two across, edge to edge, trimming the mat out at 282 × 100 mm — the same rectangle on both sides, so one pass serves both faces. Front: three 70 mm frames with 6 mm gutters. Back: four 66 mm with 4 mm gutters. The mat fits a 中托盘 (32.5 × 25 cm) with about 1 cm of play; it does NOT fit a 小托盘 (25 × 20 cm) — Tray 1 must be a medium tray.
items.howToPrint: Print 1 sheet DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100% on card; cut along every grey line; matt-laminate.

items.title: Chain cards ×6
items.cut: Cut along every grey line — two strokes across the sheet, two down it, edge to edge — for four butted cards of 80 × 120 mm. Mounted on a coloured backing card with a 1 cm border they finish at 100 × 140 mm. Black triangles in the margin mark every line; they land in the same place on both faces, so front cuts and back cuts coincide.
items.howToPrint: Print 2 sheets DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%; four 80 × 120 mm cards per sheet.

items.title: Dictation photo cards ×12
items.cut: Cut along every grey line — two strokes across the sheet, two down it, edge to edge — for four butted cards of 80 × 120 mm. Mounted on a coloured backing card with a 1 cm border they finish at 100 × 140 mm. Black triangles in the margin mark every line; they land in the same place on both faces, so front cuts and back cuts coincide.
items.howToPrint: Print 3 sheets DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%; four 80 × 120 mm cards per sheet.

items.title: Small objects — 5 heart words, 7 blanks, 3 punctuation tiles
items.cut: Cut along every grey line: 15 butted pieces in ONE three-column grid — 12 cards at 60 × 35 mm and 3 punctuation tiles at 60 × 42 mm, unmounted. The tiles were widened from 34 mm so that every piece is the same width and every line, across and down, runs edge to edge. A 60 × 42 tile still lies flat in a mint tin. Punch the rings.
items.howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on thick card; LAMINATE the whole sheet, THEN cut.

items.title: Lined sentence strips, 190 × 60 mm
items.cut: Cut along every grey line: 4 butted strips, 190 × 60 mm, unmounted.
items.howToPrint: Print plenty, single-sided at 100% on plain paper; 4 strips per sheet.

items.title: Picture sequences ×3 (12 cards)
items.cut: Cut along every grey line: 4 butted cards a sheet at 70 × 70 mm, three sheets, one complete set a sheet. Mounted on a coloured backing card with a 1 cm border they finish at 90 × 90 mm and still drop into the 10 × 10 cm envelopes.
items.howToPrint: Print 3 sheets single-sided at 100% on card; one complete set per sheet, four 70 × 70 mm cards.

items.title: Fold-book template
items.cut: One cut, along the amber line in the middle of the sheet. Three folds.
items.howToPrint: Print single-sided at 100% (never “fit to page”); one sheet = one 8-page book.

items.title: Story-dictation sheet
items.howToPrint: Print 20 copies single-sided at 100% on plain paper; keep them in one folder.

items.title: Teacher script card, 2-up A5
items.cut: One cut down the middle, edge to edge between the two black triangles: two identical A5 cards, 148.5 × 210 mm. The two halves are the whole sheet, so there is no waste for anything else.
items.howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on card; one cut; laminate both.

items.title: Grammar pack — 12 tokens + 4 control cards
items.cut: 16 pieces: 12 tokens on page 1, 4 cards at 190 × 60 mm on page 2.
items.howToPrint: Print 2 sheets single-sided in colour at 100%; LAMINATE both sheets, THEN cut.

items.title: Backup object cards × 26 — 50 × 50 mm
items.cut: Cut along every grey line: 26 butted cards at 50 × 50 mm, unmounted — 15 on sheet 1 and 11 on sheet 2, plus 4 blank squares at the end of sheet 2 that cut into spare cards. Every object now has a photograph: sun, pot, pan and tin come from the Montessori picture bank.
items.howToPrint: Print 2 sheets single-sided at 100% on card; LAMINATE each sheet, THEN cut.

revised: 2026-09-05 (late, round 2) — CUT ONCE throughout, sheet 01 included. Flip cards 02/03 are RE-LAID, not shrunk: the photograph is lifted out of the old quadrant and re-placed at 72 × 72 mm on the 80 × 120 card, and the word on the back is scaled up to a 20 mm cap height.
